scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,frontend "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
